text:
Alex Turner: Anyone up for a spontaneous LAN tonight? Thinking roguelites + a Smash mini-tourney. :joystick:
Priya Singh: I can bring Switch + dock and a power strip. What roguelites do we want? Hades, Spelunky, Dead Cells?
Mateo Alvarez: Ill bring my Steam Deck and Risk of Rain 2. Can host a local lobby if wifi holds. Link for folks: https://store.steampowered.com/app/632360/Risk_of_Rain_2/
Jin Park: Im in. Ill bring ethernet cables and a Bluetooth speaker. Smash side tourney sounds sick :trophy:
Alex Turner: Quick format idea: 3-round single elimination for Smash so people can jump in/out.
Priya Singh: Emoji poll for main roguelite: :one: Hades, :two: Spelunky, :three: Dead Cells, :four: Risk of Rain 2. React with your pick.
Mateo Alvarez: PSA for Deck players: if inputs feel laggy, try streaming Deck -> PC with controller passthrough and disable Steam overlay. Settings > Controller > General Controller Settings. Helped me.
Jin Park: Smash rules proposal: 2-stock, 8m timer, items off, Omega allowed. Keep matches brisk.
OpsBot: Reservation confirmed: Mezzanine "LAN-C" 7:00pm-11:00pm. RSVPs: Alex Turner, Priya Singh, Mateo Alvarez, Jin Park.
Priya Singh: Ill make a tiny bracket + snack sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/roguelan-brackets — add your name and what youre bringing.
Alex Turner: Ill bring spare controllers, HDMI adapters, and a power strip. @here see you 7pm, snacks highly encouraged :pizza:
